title: Improved the end-to-end docs reading flow
points: The overview now includes a short first-user path that connects a real equities query, trace inspection, database coverage checks, and changelog validation.
Pipeline artifacts now collapse behind view controls and each major stage explains why the check matters before showing detailed examples.
The database section now shows its public/admin explanation before live health data finishes loading, and the changelog can be filtered by system theme.
Pipeline, database, and design-choice sections now link to related production fixes so readers can connect architecture decisions to concrete changes.
